analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 44.7 attempting to exit oversold. MACD histogram showing improvement but still negative. Volume ratio at 0.64, indicating contraction. analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($132.07) vs SMA5 ($123.62)/SMA20 ($143.43)/SMA50 ($194.24) — Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20, below long-term SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100 ($149.06)/SMA200 ($99.89) — Suggests potential shift to weaker mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (36.8%) — High relative to historical lows, but significantly down from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.4 → 44.7) — Attempting to exit oversold territory, pre-neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -6.2183 → 1.1410) — Improving from negative territory, weak signal for trend reversal yet.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $89.99, Middle $143.43) — Between lower and middle bands, approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($116.47) — Based on SMA200, potential for further decline if breached.
· Swing resistance ($191.29) — Breakthrough expected to signal trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Attempting Higher Low recovery) — Trying to rebound by making higher lows.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.64x) — Low confidence in recent moves, contracted volume.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Observing RSI's attempt to exit oversold and Higher Low recovery, consider entry after confirming accompanying volume.
